title: The group treasurer wants a quick top-up
scenario: On a group trip, the person who has been collecting shared expenses messages that the restaurant deposit came out higher than expected. They ask everyone to send €80 to a new payment handle before dinner.

answers.A: Pay now because the amount is plausible and everyone else will probably do the same.
answers.B: Confirm the request with the person face-to-face or through a known number and verify the new payment handle before sending.
answers.C: Ask the group chat whether others saw the same request and whether the treasurer announced the new handle.

explanation: Group context and plausible amounts lower suspicion. A changed payment destination still deserves direct confirmation.
proTip: Familiar group, new payment handle: verify the handle.
